delete.summary:
Delete an unsubmitted Draft (AppointmentStatusID = 5) for the supplied
student ID. The appointmentId is the same ID used by Draft update/submit.
Example: DELETE /api/appointment-drafts/101?idNumber=2023001

200.description: Draft deleted; returns appointmentId and message.

400.description: Invalid request or other business validation failure.

404.description: Draft not found for the appointmentId and idNumber.

409.description: Appointment is no longer a Draft.

ConstantDto.description:
Shared shape for the constant lookup tables. Each table has an integer id
column (AppointmentTypeID, ConcernTypeID, AttendanceStatusID,
AppointmentStatusID, SessionTypeID, SpecialistReferralID) and a single
text column (the type/status name, or SpecialistRole). The repository maps
CounselLink.API.DTOs.ConstantDto.Id and CounselLink.API.DTOs.ConstantDto.Value onto the correct per-type
stored-procedure parameter names.

employeeID.description: Counselor employee id (derived from the appointment if omitted).

idNumber.description: Student ID number (derived from the appointment if omitted).

generalNotes.description: General session notes (required by the procedure).

startTime.description: Preferred start time (HH:mm:ss); overrides legacy appointmentTime.

referredBy.description: Who referred the student, if applicable.

CreateAppointmentDto.description:

dbo.spAppointment_Insert parameters exactly.

appointmentDate.description: Preferred date+startTime+endTime; old newStartDate/newEndDate still accepted.

resolutionNotes.example: Reviewed updated grades with the student.

isForMonitoring.description: Whether the student is flagged for monitoring.

UpdateAppointmentDto.description:
Request payload for PUT /api/appointments/{id}. Property names match the
dbo.spAppointment_Update parameters exactly (the appointment id comes from
the route and is supplied as @AppointmentID by the repository).
